answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31648 Country: Pakistan Title: I work in military. Question: I work in military. There are mixed gatherings which are compulsory to be joined. Men and women sit separately but there is no physical partition between them. Now, if I refuse to join I may be put into trouble by bad posting stations and dismissal from service. It is permissible to join such gatherings while safe guarding ones own eyes. Answer ID: 31648 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 827/533/H=1432) In the case mentioned above, it may be allowable to join it safeguarding your eyes and heart. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
